title: Product Upload VA / E-commerce Listing Assistant
description:
Product Upload VA / E-commerce Listing Assistant



We are an established Australian e-commerce business specialising in designer lighting and furniture. We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented VA to help with product uploading, product listings, spreadsheets, and e-commerce data entry.



This is a long-term role for the right person. Experience with BigCommerce, Shopify, spreadsheets, or product uploads is highly preferred.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your tasks will include:



- Uploading products to BigCommerce and/or Shopify

- Creating and updating product listings

- Organising product data in Google Sheets

- Preparing product upload spreadsheets

- Importing and exporting product CSV files

- Checking product images, SKUs, pricing, dimensions and descriptions

- Updating product categories, brands, options and variations

- Formatting product descriptions

- Creating simple product labels or graphics in Canva



AI AND PRODUCT LISTING SKILLS



We prefer someone who is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to work faster and improve product listings.



You may use AI to help with:



- Product titles

- Product descriptions

- Bullet points

- Formatting messy supplier information

- Turning product specs into clean spreadsheet data

- Checking grammar and spelling

- Creating consistent listing formats



AI should be used to assist the work, not replace careful checking. You must still check product details carefully before uploading.



SOFTWARE / PLATFORM EXPERIENCE

- BigCommerce

- Shopify

- Google Sheets

- Excel

- Canva

- ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini

- Strong attention to detail

- Good written English

- Product upload or data entry experience

- Strong spreadsheet skills

- Comfortable with CSV imports/exports

- Reliable and organised

- Tech savvy and quick to learn

- Reliable computer and stable internet connection

- You must be available during these hours

- If performance is strong, this may increase to full-time hours later

- Long-term stable role

- Opportunity to increase hours over time

- Long-term team environment

title: SEO & Organic Growth Manager – Women's Wellness & Pleasure Brand
description:
About Us:

We're a women?focused brand creating high?quality, body?safe toys and massagers. Our mission is to normalize pleasure, empower women to explore their bodies without shame, and offer honest, educational content — not just products.



The Role:

We need someone who understands that selling pleasure products requires a smart, sensitive organic growth strategy. You'll help women discover us when they search for terms like "best massager," "how to use a toy," or "pelvic floor relaxation" — while navigating platform restrictions (Google Ads limitations, Reddit community rules, guest posting policies in the wellness space).



Required Tools Experience:

Proficient in Ahrefs (keyword research, competitor gap analysis, backlink audits) plus:



· Google Search Console

· Optional but helpful: SEMrush, SurferSEO



What you'll help us with:



1. SEO Strategy 



· Keyword research for pleasure/wellness terms (many are high?intent but restricted on some platforms)

· Competitor analysis — who ranks for the best keywords 

· On?page SEO for product pages, educational guides, and blog content

· Technical SEO  + fixes



2. Organic Growth & Link Building (our industry savvy)



· Guest posts: Identify wellness, education, relationship, and feminist blogs that accept links to pleasure products.

· Reddit strategy (carefully)

· Unlinked mentions: Find blogs or forums mentioning "women owned toy brands" without linking — and politely request a link

· Affiliate partnerships: Identify influencers and bloggers who can link to us.



3. Google Ads (basic knowledge)



· Google restricts certain adult keywords. You'll help us understand what's allowed (educational content, brand terms, non?explicit wellness language) versus what's not

· Set up small test campaigns using approved terms (e.g., "self care gifts for women," "stress relief massager")

We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on Director of Operations to serve as the strategic and functional backbone of our business. We are a woman-owned, USDA Organic tea company specializing in a unique line of bagless, pressed teas. This is a high-impact role for an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in a small-team environment and is ready to own the demand planning, supply chain, and financial operations oversight for a growing CPG brand. This is not a purely supervisory role; you will be "in the systems" daily, driving continuity across a lean operation in an active growth and profitability phase. 



Work Structure & Requirements

• Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor. 

• Hours: 25–30 hours per week. 

• Schedule: Monday–Friday, PST business hours. 

• Location: Remote (US-based preferred). 

• Reporting: Reports directly to the Founder & CEO. 

• Team Oversight: Manage and direct an Ops Admin who handles day-to-day transaction processing and 3PL coordination.

1. Demand Planning & Supply Chain

• Own the demand forecast and translate projections into weekly production schedules and purchase plans. 

• Manage ingredient and packaging procurement, including vendor selection, PO issuance, and price negotiation. 

• Maintain reorder points and safety stock levels across all SKUs while balancing inventory investment against cash flow constraints. 

• Model scenarios for demand and supply changes and communicate implications to leadership. 

2. Production & Kitchen Operations

• Own the production schedule in coordination with the Production Manager. 

• Oversee the quality program, including batch production records (BPRs), product specs, and organic certification maintenance. 

• Manage production assemblies and cost allocation in the inventory management system. 

• Ensure the facility remains audit-ready on an ongoing basis. 

3. 3PL & Logistics Oversight

• Oversee 3PL relationships at a strategic level and direct the Ops Admin on daily coordination. 

• Review and dispute incorrect 3PL charges (freight, kitting, storage) to advocate for the business. 

• Manage outbound logistics strategy across DTC, Amazon, and wholesale channels. 

4. Wholesale & Retail Channel Operations

• Oversee operations for active wholesale accounts and manage TrueCommerce/EDI account oversight. 

• Own deductions tracking and dispute management for distributors and retailers. 

• Ensure routing guide compliance and customer-specific requirements are met. 

5. Financial Operations & Systems Integrity

• Hold invoice approval authority across freight, POs, and vendor invoices via 
. 

• Contribute to weekly cash flow planning and review monthly financials for operational expense accuracy. 

• Oversee data integrity across all platforms (DEAR/Cin7 Core, Extensiv, QuickBooks, Shopify). 

• Identify process inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions and SOPs. 



Required Skills & Experience

• Experience: 5+ years in operations, supply chain, or logistics, with at least 2 years in a CPG, food manufacturing, or e-commerce environment. 

• System Mastery: Hands-on experience with DEAR/Cin7 Core is non-negotiable; you will be in this system daily. 

• Planning: Demonstrated experience owning demand planning and procurement in a small-team environment. 

• Judgment: Comfortable making purchasing decisions in a cash-constrained environment. 

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication for professional representation with vendors and partners. 



Preferred Skills

• Experience with Extensiv (WMS), TrueCommerce (EDI), or similar platforms. 

• Familiarity with organic certification (CCOF), FSMA compliance, or food safety programs. 

• QuickBooks familiarity and comfort reading P&Ls and cash flow statements. 



To Apply

title: Outbound Appointment Setter — Cold Calling & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We’re hiring a confident, outcome-focused Virtual Assistant to run cold-calling outreach using our knowledge base. This is not a script-reader role — you’ll use structured content and product knowledge to engage prospects, qualify leads, and book qualified meetings. Quick thinking, clear communication, and disciplined note-taking into our knowledge base are essential.





What you’ll do

- Use our knowledge base and call scripts as a starting point — adapt language to each prospect naturally.

- Make outbound cold calls to prospects on supplied lists (phone + CRM).

- Qualify leads to a tight brief: needs, budget range, timeline, decision-makers, and next steps.

- Book discovery/demo calls directly on the calendar for our sales team.

- Log call outcomes, notes, and follow-up tasks in the knowledge base and CRM immediately after each call.

- Run follow-up calls and reminder sequences per playbook until prospect responds or is disqualified.

- Escalate complex or technical questions to the assigned SME and update the knowledge base with new FAQs or clarifications.

- Hit daily/weekly call and meeting targets and maintain call quality standards.

- Provide short weekly reports: calls made, contacts reached, qualified leads, common objections, and suggested knowledge-base updates.



Who we’re looking for

- Comfortable with cold calling and objection handling — you don’t hang up early.

- Strong verbal communication and fast thinker on the phone.

- Able to learn and reference a product/service knowledge base quickly and accurately.

- CRM-savvy (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar) and disciplined about logging data.

- Reliable, punctual, and professional on calls.

- Persistent but respectful — you push for outcomes without being spammy.

- Able to follow a playbook but adapt language to sound human and relevant.

- Comfortable with performance tracking and meeting weekly targets.



Tools & systems

- You’ll work from our shared knowledge base (structured articles, objection scripts, product sheets).

- CRM access for logging and call lists.

- Calendar tool for booking meetings.

- Must have a quiet workspace and reliable internet/phone setup.



Performance expectations

- Daily: X outbound calls (we’ll agree target), accurate CRM updates for each call.

- Weekly: Y qualified meetings booked (target set during onboarding).

- Quality: Clear call notes, correct qualification per our brief, and timely knowledge-base updates where needed.



What success looks like in 30/60/90 days

- 30 days: Confidently navigating the knowledge base, meeting call activity targets, regularly qualifying leads to brief.

- 60 days: Consistently hitting meeting-booking goals, reducing average time to qualify, contributing useful knowledge-base improvements.

- 90 days: Reliable pipeline contributor, few errors in CRM logging, proactive in proposing refinements to scripts and playbooks.



Apply only if you have real cold-calling experience and can demonstrate consistent results. In your application, answer briefly:

1. How many outbound cold calls did you make per day in your last role, and what meeting/qualified-lead rate did you achieve?

2. Describe how you would use a knowledge base during a call when a prospect asks a technical question you don’t know the answer to.

3. Give one short example of a time you turned a difficult objection into a booked meeting — what you said and what happened next.



To apply, include a short voice sample (1–2 minutes) of you making a prospecting call (real or role-played) and a brief note on which CRM you’ve used.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Participate in planning, testing, debugging, and deployment activities

title: Foreclosure Assistance Specialist
description:
REMOTE WORK OPPORTUNITY!! PLEASE READ INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY BEFORE SENDING OUT YOUR APPLICATION!



Foreclosure Assistance Specialist

Direct Employer | Remote

Rate: $5–$6/hour (based on experience)



Role Overview:

As a Foreclosure Assistance Specialist, you will speak with homeowners who are seeking help in

postponing or extending their foreclosure/auction date. You will guide them through our services,

answer their questions, and help them feel confident in choosing our service. Strong communication

and conversational skills are essential, along with the ability to subtly encourage enrollment without

sounding overly sales-focused.



Requirements:

- Strong conversational ability; confident and empathetic on calls

CSR or phone-based support experience preferred

- PST working hours 

- Ability to submit a natural-sounding voice recording (reading any short article)



What We Offer:

- Paid training

- Sign-up bonus after successful completion of the trial period

- Urgent hiring



How to Apply:



 your CV to 

Subject line: SAP – Foreclosure Assistance Specialist – [Your Name]

Attach a link to your voice recording reading the article below using 



1. What Is a Foreclosure Postponement?

“Many homeowners facing foreclosure are unaware that they may qualify for a postponement. A foreclosure postponement is a temporary delay granted by the county or court, giving the homeowner more time to gather documents, explore loss-mitigation options, or secure financial assistance. This extra time can be crucial, especially when homeowners are dealing with unexpected hardships. Understanding the process and deadlines is essential to increasing the chances of a successful postponement.”

2. Why Acting Early Matters in Foreclosure Situations

“When a homeowner receives a Notice of Default or an auction date, time becomes their most valuable resource. Acting early allows them to review options such as negotiating with their lender, filing for postponement, or exploring repayment plans. Many homeowners wait until the last few weeks, which limits their options. Early action can reduce stress and significantly improve the outcome of their case.”

3. The Importance of Verified Court Filings in Foreclosure Cases

“Submitting accurate and timely court filings can make a big difference in a foreclosure situation. Counties require specific documents, strict formatting, and deadlines that must be met exactly. Missing a requirement can cause delays or an automatic denial. That’s why many homeowners choose to work with assistance programs that specialize in preparing and filing documents on their behalf. Proper filing helps homeowners buy valuable time and avoid losing their property prematurely.”

4. Understanding Your Rights as a Homeowner Facing Foreclosure

“Homeowners facing foreclosure often feel overwhelmed, but it is important to remember that they still have rights. They have the right to receive proper notice, the right to request information from their lender, and in many cases, the right to seek postponement or review options. Knowing these rights helps homeowners make informed decisions rather than reacting out of fear. Education and support can make the process less intimidating.”

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
Base: 80,000 PHP/month + Performance Bonus

Wellness Day Off after probation



We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



?



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



?



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



?



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



?



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: Fulltime VA for Australian Real Estate Agency — Tenant Outreach & Lead Research, (Mon–Fri)
description:
About the Role

We're a licensed Australian real estate agency specialising in medium-term furnished rentals (1–6 months) for relocating professionals, families, and corporate travellers. We're hiring our first full-time VA to become the operational backbone of the business — essentially the right hand to the agency owner, taking ownership of the day-to-day work that keeps the agency running.



This is a broad, varied role for someone who wants real responsibility and long-term stability. You won't be siloed into one task — you'll touch most parts of the business, from tenant outreach to tenant verification to listing maintenance to admin. We'll train you on each area, and over time you'll own more of it independently.



What You'll Do

The work shifts week to week, but the core areas are:

Tenant outreach and lead generation. Logging into our paid premium account on a major Australian rental platform daily, filtering new tenant seekers against our listings, and sending personalised messages from templates we'll provide. Handling initial replies, qualifying genuine leads, and escalating the strong ones to the agency owner.



 group research. Monitoring a list of Sydney and Melbourne rental groups daily, identifying posts from people looking for rentals that match our listings, and logging them in a Google Sheet for the owner to follow up personally. You won't post or comment on
 yourself.



Listing maintenance. Rotating 
 across Flatmates and
 on a schedule, keeping listing content fresh, and updating availability across platforms as bookings come in.



Tenant verification and reference checks. Reviewing tenant applications, checking payslips and bank statements, contacting referees, and preparing a clear summary for the owner to make the final decision. We'll train you on what to look for.

Inbox and enquiry management. Triaging the 
 responding to routine enquiries from a script library, and flagging anything that needs the owner's attention.



Admin and reporting. End-of-day Google Sheet update covering messages sent, replies received, posts flagged, and applications processed. Plus ad-hoc admin tasks as they come up.



There are a few areas you won't be involved in: legal document edits, pricing decisions, anything involving our SA real estate licence, Stripe and payments, and formal compliance correspondence. Those stay with the owner.



What We're Looking For

Strong written and spoken English (you will also take phone calls from Australian clients) — please include a writing sample (see below).

Previous experience working with Australian clients, especially in real estate, property management, or relocation services (highly preferred but not essential if your writing and judgement are strong).

Comfortable with Google Sheets,
,
, and picking up new web-based tools quickly. You don't need to be technical, but you do need to be confident learning systems.

Good judgement. A lot of this role involves reading a situation — a tenant profile, an enquiry
, a
 post — and making a sensible call without every rule spelled out. We'll give you scripts and frameworks, but we need someone who can think.

Reliable daily presence. We need consistency over bursts of activity. A steady eight hours every weekday matters more than working late occasionally.

Honest and communicative. If something's gone wrong, or you're unsure, or you've made a mistake — flag it early. We'd rather hear about a small problem at 9am than a big one at 5pm.

Long-term mindset. We're building a stable role with room to grow, not filling a short gig. The right person will take on more responsibility, and pay, over time.

Reporting and Support

You'll report day-to-day to the owner's mother, Tammy (Australia-based, available during your morning), who handles the Australian-hours side of operations. The agency owner is based in Germany and will be available later in your day. Between the two of us, you'll always have someone to escalate to.



Hours

Full time, Monday to Friday.

Preferred shift: 10am–6pm Adelaide time (7:30am–3:30pm Manila time during AU daylight saving; 6:30am–2:30pm Manila time outside it). Some flexibility possible for the right person.



Pay

Starting at $4 USD per hour, paid weekly, with reviews after 6 months. After a successful trial, we move to a stable monthly retainer. Pay rises as you take on more responsibility — this is genuinely a role that grows.



To Apply

Please send:



A short paragraph about your previous experience with Australian clients (real estate or property management especially welcome).



A writing sample. Imagine you're messaging a tenant on a rental platform with this profile: "Sarah, 32, relocating to Sydney fro
lbourne for a new hospital job, looking for a 2-bed in the eastern suburbs, budget $1,200/week, dates flexible Feb–March, travelling with partner." Write a friendly, personalised first message (3–5 sentences) introducing a hypothetical 2-bed furnished apartment in Bondi at $1,150/week.



Your earliest available start date.



Applications without the writing sample will not be considered. We'll respond to all complete applications within 5 business days, and shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short Zoom interview where we'll share more about the agency.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
If you want to be part of a growing small business that's building with AI and shipping fast, you'll like it here.



If you're tired of being one of a hundred engineers maintaining a service you didn't design, this is the opposite. You own the whole stack. You pick your tools. Your work ships in days, not quarters.



About:

The Mousepad Company is a small US-based DTC brand. We make premium gaming and desk mousepads, printed in-house in California. The team is lean and the owner is hands-on. We ship constantly.



The job:

You are the owner's technical right hand. Build and maintain our internal app (OPPY) and our customer-facing creator studio (MPCO Studio). You are the only software person on the team. You ship features, integrations, dashboards, and automations: whatever the business needs that week. We do not have a Jira full of cleanly-scoped tickets waiting for you. You help us figure out what to build next.



What you do:



Phase 1, OPPY (first 30 to 60 days):

Take a list of feature requests and ship them. Make the app more efficient, then faster, then more beautiful, in that order. Examples of what we'll ask for: "I click this button and this data shows up." "This page loads in 4 seconds, get it under 1." "This workflow takes 5 clicks, get it to 2."



Phase 2, MPCO Studio:

Custom mousepad designer web app. Think Figma but exporting creates a print file. More details to be discussed later.



Ongoing:

Slack custom commands. Notion to Shopify integrations. 
 to Creator Studio integrations. Financial dashboards. Helping the team use AI better. Internal tools that do not exist yet. When you run out of assigned work, you find what is slow or broken and fix it.



Compensation:

Monthly salary, paid via Wise. Long-term role. Quarterly performance review with potential raises for top performers.



What we need from you:



You ship fast and constantly. Your last side project shipped in a weekend, not a year.

You live in modern AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, similar) and have opinions on which is best for what.

You are a generalist. You can build a Slack bot in the morning, debug a Shopify webhook at lunch, and ship a financial dashboard in the afternoon.

You read a stack you have never used and ship in it within a week.

You self-direct. Nobody assigns you tickets. You find what matters and do it.

Strong written English.

Willing to work West Coast US hours.



Nice to have:



Built something with creator economy or affiliate program tech before.

Built a design canvas or image-generation tool before.

Shopify, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Railway on your résumé.

Slack bots, 
 bots, or Notion integrations on your résumé.



A note up front: AI is a tool you live in for this role, so we don't ban it in your application. But generic AI-generated answers are filtered out immediately. Use AI to help you express yourself, not to do the thinking.



To apply, send:



Ship proof.

Link us to something you built recently, alone. Could be a side project, a tool, an integration, anything that ships. Tell us in 3 sentences how long it took and what tools you used to build it.

Workflow Loom.

Record a 90-second Loom screen-share of your actual coding workflow. Show us your editor, your AI tools, how you move. Don't perform. Just show us what a normal afternoon looks like.

Generalist test.

Pick one of these three and tell us in plain English how you'd build it. No code, just your approach.

(a) A Slack command that pulls last week's blended MER from a PostgreSQL database.

(b) A Shopify webhook that auto-creates a Notion task every time a refund over $100 is processed.

title: Executive Assistant — Medical Practice (Remote, Philippines)
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT — MEDICAL PRACTICE (REMOTE, PHILIPPINES)

Reports to: Practice founder (cardiac electrophysiologist)

Compensation: $12–14/hour USD + $100/month HMO allowance after 90 days



ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a cardiac electrophysiologist (heart rhythm specialist) launching a solo medical practice in the Los Angeles area this summer. I'm looking for one excellent, long-term executive assistant to work with me directly — handling the wide range of administrative, operational, and light medical-administrative work that comes with running a small specialty practice.



This is a full-time, remote, long-term position based in the Philippines. You'll be the one person I rely on to keep things organized, follow through, and steadily take more off my plate over time. I want someone who will grow into this role and stay for years, not someone looking for a stepping stone.



One thing to know upfront: I'm new to working with a dedicated EA. I'm an expert in medicine, not in delegation. The right candidate will help me build the working relationship — establishing our communication rhythm, teaching me what to hand off, and setting up the systems that make us both effective. If you've successfully onboarded a first-time EA principal before, that experience matters here.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



The work is varied. In any given week, you might:



• Manage my calendar,
, and communications — including scheduling with patients, vendors, hospital staff, and professional contacts

• Draft, format, and proofread documents, letters, and presentations

• Handle patient-related administrative tasks: records requests, intake form follow-up, scheduling, basic chart organization (HIPAA compliance is critical)

• Coordinate with outside vendors — credentialing services, billing partners, EMR vendor, real estate broker, IT, attorneys, etc.

• Build and document repeatable processes for the practice (intake, scheduling, follow-ups, billing handoffs) — writing the SOPs we'll use as we grow

• Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, others) to draft, summarize, research, and automate routine work — and help me figure out where else AI can save time

• Track to-dos, deadlines, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams so nothing falls through the cracks

• Occasional personal administrative tasks (travel, appointments, household coordination) — minority of the work, but real



WHO YOU ARE



You're highly organized, proactive, and a clear writer. You follow through without being chased. You ask good questions when something is ambiguous and you make sensible decisions when it isn't. You're tech-comfortable and pick up new tools quickly. You're comfortable taking the lead on shaping the working relationship with a first-time EA employer.



REQUIRED



• 3+ years of executive or administrative assistant experience supporting a busy professional, ideally a solo founder or small business owner

• Minimum 2 years of experience working in a US-based medical practice (specialty practice strongly preferred; cardiology, electrophysiology, or internal medicine a particular plus)

• Working familiarity with HIPAA and secure handling of patient information

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-through

• Comfortable working independently with limited supervision

• Fluent in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

• Able to overlap 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Pacific Time daily



BIG PLUSES (not required — but tell me if you have them)



• Cardiology, electrophysiology, or internal medicine practice experience specifically

• Experience with US EHR systems

• Experience documenting and improving processes (SOPs, checklists, workflow design)

• Experience using LLMs and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) in real work — drafting, research, automation, prompt design. This matters to me. If you've integrated AI into your workflow in interesting ways, tell me about it specifically.

• Workflow automation experience with Zapier, 
, or similar

• Project/task management fluency in Asana, ClickUp, Notion, or Airtable



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• $12–14/hour USD, depending on experience

• $100/month HMO (health insurance) allowance after successful completion of a 90-day probationary period

• Paid time off after the first 90 days

• Paid weekly or biweekly (your choice) via Wise or your preferred PH-friendly payment method



HARDWARE AND WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS



• Reliable high-speed internet with a backup plan for outages (mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, or similar)

• Quiet, dedicated workspace free from background noise

• Modern computer capable of comfortable multitasking and video conferencing

• Headset suitable for professional video calls



TO APPLY

 or phone number

title: Product Designer – Longshot Labs
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Designer to be the first dedicated design hire at Longshot, a prediction market focused on deep liquidity and user experience. You will work directly with the founders to build the product experience from the ground up, owning everything from initial ideation to production-ready specs.

What You'll Do

Own the core product experience 

You'll be the design voice for Longshot's most critical surfaces, including the trading and markets pages where users place predictions, and the onboarding flows that turn new visitors into active traders. You'll think in real interactions: order states, loading behaviors, edge cases, empty states, and the small 
nts that make a product feel trustworthy rather than thrown together.

Build and evolve the design system 

You will take ownership of a design system that has some initial components, but is still in development. You will walk through what already exists, establish component standards, define tokens, and build a library that scales as the product grows. Your system will be the foundation that lets the rest of the team ship faster without losing consistency.

Drive ideation to handoff 

You will be in the room from the earliest conversations through to engineering handoff. That means contributing to requirements discussions, iterating quickly on concepts, producing clean Figma files with clear components and annotations, and providing clarifications as engineers perform wiring.

Think like an owner 

You'll have bi-weekly design reviews directly with the founders and a seat at the table on product decisions. We want someone who voices their opinions when something doesn't serve the user and measures success by the look of the final product.

Drive decisions related to graphic, branding, and marketing assets

Longshot's visual identity doesn't stop at the app. You'll own how we look everywhere else too: the marketing site, brand assets, graphics, all of it. Same care, same eye, same standards as the product. When something looks off, you'll catch it. And you'll fix it.

What We're Looking For

You have 1 to 4 years of experience as a product or UX designer, ideally at a startup. You're deeply comfortable in Figma. You use AI tools to naturally complement your workflow, but major decisions are still driven by your thinking. You have strong interaction design instincts and think in systems and flows, not just individual screens. You are intrinsically motivated and thrive in a remote environment.

Bonus points if you have

Prior exposure to crypto, consumer-facing applications, and/or gaming interfaces

Experience building or contributing to a design system early on

Some background in user research or usability testing

An eye for motion and microinteractions that make dense UIs feel alive

What success looks like

In your first few months, you'll have continued to maintain the design system, owned end-to-end design for at least two major product surfaces, and built a design rhythm with the founding team that keeps quality high as we move quickly. Over time, you'll become the design standard-bearer for Longshot, and as the team grows, you'll help define what great design looks like.

What We Offer

Meaningful ownership with significant equity as the first design hire

Direct access to founders with a real voice in product direction from day one

A fully remote, high-trust environment where you own your work

Real impact: your designs ship to real users quickly

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT VA - SHOPIFY ECOMMERCE (REMOTE, LONG-TERM)
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST - ECOMMERCE (DROPSHIPPING)

Remote | Part-Time | 4-6 Hours Per Day | 7 Days a Week

$3-4 per hour (approximately PHP 209/hour) | Growth opportunities for long-term contributors



-------------------------



This is a long-term role. We are not looking for someone for one month. We want someone we can grow with, give more responsibility to, and pay more over time. Our existing CS team has been with us for years, and we want the same for this new hire.



-------------------------



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will handle customer
 tickets for our Shopify-based ecommerce dropshipping brand. That means working through an inbox of 80 to 100 tickets per shift in Gorgias: order status inquiries, cancellation requests, returns and refunds, damaged or lost package cases, and size or quality complaints. You will use our documented SOPs and reply macros to resolve cases consistently, professionally, and with care.



This is not a chat role, not a phone role, and not a social media role. It is
 ticket handling in Gorgias, every day.



-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Reply to customer
 tickets in Gorgias using our documented SOPs and reply macros

- Hit team KPIs on First Response Time (FRT) and resolution time

- Coordinate with our Supply Chain and Disputes teams when cases require handoff

- Process refunds, replacements, and partial refunds within the approved decision tree

- Escalate cases that fall outside policy to the CS Manager with a clear summary

- Flag products with recurring complaints to the Quality team on a weekly basis

- Keep clean notes on tickets so handoffs are seamless

-------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE FROM DAY 1



- A full Customer Support SOP covering every scenario you will encounter

- Gorgias reply macros for common situations (cancellations, RTS, damaged items, lost in transit, and more)

- A Risky Products SOP for weekly product quality reporting

- Direct access to the CS Manager for escalations and questions

- An existing CS team to learn from, not a brand new setup

You do not need to invent the playbook. We have built it. You need to execute it cleanly and consistently.



-------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience in ecommerce customer support, dropshipping customer support, OR Shopify-based CS (any combination works, dropshipping experience is a strong plus)

- Experience with Gorgias OR a comparable ticketing tool (Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk). Direct Gorgias is preferred but we can train on it quickly if you have strong Zendesk experience.

- Comfort handling 80 to 100 tickets per shift without falling behind

- Strong written English: clear, empathetic, and professional

- Reliable internet and your own computer

Bonus (not required):

- Prior experience handling RTS (return-to-sender) situations

- Familiarity with chargebacks and dispute processes in dropshipping

- Prior experience with EU customers and their return expectations

-------------------------



SCHEDULE - READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This role is 7 days a week, every week. Our customers
 every day including weekends and public holidays. If you cannot commit to working 7 days a week, please do not apply. We will not make exceptions, and applying anyway only wastes both our time.



You can flex your specific working hours within the day as long as tickets are handled within our FRT target.



-------------------------



COMPENSATION DETAILS



Paid weekly via Wise. Rate grows with performance and tenure, we promote from within for team leads and specialist roles.



-------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review.



1. Put the word BALI in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject.

2. In your application message, answer these 4 questions in order. Answer each inline, no attachments, no Loom videos at this stage.

Q1. How long have you worked in ecommerce customer support, what kind of responsibilities did you have, and for what type of companies (dropshipping, DTC, marketplace, etc.)? Name the actual companies and your role there in detail.



Q2. Describe one difficult customer ticket you resolved. What was the issue, what did the customer want, and how did you handle it? Keep it specific.



Q3. What ticketing tools have you used (Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk, etc.)? What ticket volume per shift have you typically handled, and what is the most you have ever handled in a shift?



Q4. Confirm your availability: hours per day, days per week (we need 7), and your working hours in your local timezone. Also confirm: are you currently employed, and if yes, what would your start date look like?



-------------------------



We read every application that follows the instructions. We are looking for one person for the long term, not a roster of temporary help.

title: Real Estate Social Media Content Manager/Editor
description:
This is a part time position with the potential for full-time within six months. PERFORMANCE BASED BONUSES AS WELL!



This role is specifically a content manager for a real estate team in the Florida Panhandle. Our YouTube channel is our primary lead generation engine, targeting families, veterans, and professionals making long-distance moves to the area. It is ran by two of the agents on the team. We want to move into Instagram and grow our social media presence. We have an AI system built and the content generated, we need someone to manage and help us post/create the short form video, etc.



On our channel, we publish long-form educational videos that are data-heavy and conversational. Our audience comes to us for honest local expertise, and our content reflects that. We have a defined brand voice and visual style that this role is expected to match exactly.



This is a content management role, not just a clipping job. You’ll own four interconnected pipelines — long-form video production, short-form distribution, AI-assisted content operations, and multi-platform social publishing. A typical week spans all four, a typical day three out of four mostly.

 

Long-Form Video Production

•     Publish finished videos to YouTube with fully optimized metadata: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, and thumbnails

•     Track video performance in YouTube Studio and report key metrics (views, watch time, CTR, subscriber impact) on a weekly basis

•.    Our videos are edited by a third party who will provide the completed video and thumnail. We post every four days. You will not be required to edit long form content.

 

Short-Form Content (YouTube Shorts, Reels)

•     Identify and cut the highest-value clips from long-form YouTube videos for distribution as Shorts and Reels.

•     Apply SEO best practices to every short: hooks, captions, hashtags, and platform-specific formatting

•     Schedule and publish across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels

•     Monitor short-form performance metrics and flag what’s working for content strategy discussions

•.    Cut and Edit 5-7 raw short form videos for Instagram Reels every week. This will be a preponderance of your duties. We          

       have the content machine already built--we record, we drop in a folder, you edit according to our brand guide, you post.

 

AI Content Operations (Claude AI)

•     Manage and operate our Claude AI content workflow — we call it our Content Machine — to generate written content from video scripts and research

•     Convert AI-generated output into polished, publish-ready blog posts formatted for our Google Business Profile pages

•     Maintain consistency between written blog content and the corresponding video — same data, same voice, same accuracy standards

•      Post Polished AI Content across 3-5 Google My Business Pages (Depending on which content). 

 

Multi-Platform Social Media Management

•     Manage content publishing and scheduling across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube, and Google My Business

•     Adapt content format and copy for each platform — what works on YouTube doesn’t always land the same on LinkedIn or other platforms.

•     Maintain the content calendar and upload tracker in Google Sheets. Provide weekly updates on specific data metrics.

•     Communicate daily progress via WhatsApp and report to the Executive Team weekly with data metrics and updated channel metrics

 

What We’re Looking For

Skills and demonstrated output matter more to us than niche background — you don’t need real estate experience to thrive, but it is an added bonus. But this is a multi-discipline role, and we need someone who can operate across video, SEO, AI tools, and social media without fail.

 

•     Proven experience editing short-form video content — show us your work

•     YouTube SEO: keyword research, title writing, descriptions, tags, and chapter markers...a willingness to learn our niche and apply everything.

•     Comfortable working inside YouTube Studio end-to-end: uploading, scheduling, metadata, and analytics

•     Experience managing or publishing content across LinkedIn,
, Instagram and Google Business pages.

•     Comfortable working with AI writing tools (Claude AI or similar) to produce and refine written content

•     Ability to write clean, clear English for blog posts, descriptions, and social captions — no fluff, no filler

•     Detail-oriented and process-driven — you’ll follow a defined style guide, not freelance the brand. All the brand guides and

•     Self-managed and reliable — async work means we’re trusting your output without daily oversight

•     Proficient with Google Drive and Google Sheets for file management and performance tracking

•     Available for at least 4–6 hours of overlap with US Central Timezones.

 

Tools You’ll Work With

•     YouTube Studio — upload management, scheduling, analytics

•     Taja.AI — AI-assisted YouTube SEO (we’ll provide access)

•     TubeBuddy — keyword research and SEO scoring (we’ll provide access)

•     Claude AI — content and description drafting

•     Google Drive & Google Sheets — file storage and content tracker

•     WhatsApp — day-to-day communication

•     Your own editing software — CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or equivalent (whatever you are comfortable with, we will get for you)

•     Go High Level - For Scheduled Content Posting -- We can teach this if you are not familiar. 

 

How to Apply



We read every application personally and move quickly on the right fit. All application materials go to 
 applications will not be reviewed. All applications must be sent via
--applications submitted on the Onlinejobs.ph platform will not be reviewed. 

 

Only
 submissions will be reviewed. Send the following in your
:

 

SUBJECT LINE: CONTENT IS MORE IMPORTANT (It's must be in all Caps):



•     Your resume.

•     2–3 examples of content you’ve edited — long-form or short-form (YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok links preferred).

•     A video introduction — 30 seconds to 1.5 minutes. Tell us who you are and why you want this role. We’re looking for personality and communication, not production value.

•     A completed BMG DISC Profile – Completely filled out including name and date

 

All additional hiring materials — including the DISC assessment — are available in our hiring folder:

 





Our Hiring Process

 

1.  Application Review — We review every
 submission. Submissions within the online jobs platform will be replied to and deleted.. If your background and DISC test are a fit, you’ll hear from us within a few business days.

One more thing — and this matters. The subject line of your

title: Resource Specialist
description:
Role Summary

The Resource Specialist serves as the primary bridge between a client’s clinical rehabilitation plan and the practical, real-world resources they need to succeed. Reporting directly to the Rehabilitation Coordinator, this role focuses on high-touch client interaction to identify social, financial, and logistical gaps and proactively sourcing solutions to fill them.



Core Responsibilities

- Direct Client Needs Assessment: Lead intensive one-on-one consultations with clients to identify specific barriers to recovery (e.g., housing instability, lack of transportation, food insecurity, or financial strain).

- Resource Mapping & Vetting: Build and maintain a comprehensive directory of community partners, NGOs, government programs, and private charities that can provide immediate assistance.

- Case Support for the RC: Act as the "boots on the ground" for the Rehab Coordinator by managing the non-clinical logistics of a client’s recovery plan.

- Application Assistance: Guide clients through the technical process of applying for social security, disability benefits, healthcare subsidies, or vocational training grants.

- Advocacy & Liaison: Contact external agencies on behalf of the client to expedite services and ensure they are receiving the full scope of available support.

- Goal Tracking: Regularly interview clients to monitor the effectiveness of provided resources and pivot strategies if a particular resource is no longer a fit.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Communication: Exceptional active listening and interviewing skills; ability to explain complex social service systems to clients clearly.

- Empathy & Professionalism: Ability to build rapport with diverse populations while maintaining clear professional boundaries.

- Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of client requests and resource tracking.

- Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to finding creative solutions for clients with limited access to traditional support systems.

Carousels

Posters

Event graphics

Quote cards

Timetable visuals

Ensure content matches each brand’s tone and identity

Add captions, hashtags, cover designs, and relevant tags



2. Marketing & Print Design

Design A4/A5 print-ready flyers, posters, leaflets, menus and brochures

Create PDF one-pagers for commissioners, parents, and partners

Prepare event branding (posters, banners, signage, menus, social promos)

Format documents for print and
 distribution



3. Scheduling & Platform Management

Schedule ALL posts 1 week in advance using Metricool

Manage content calendar across all brands

Ensure NO posting days are missed

Upload content correctly to Instagram,

Optimise posting times

title: Short-form Video editor for Meta ads
description:
About Us

We're Tufttea Studios — a tufting workshop business running creative rug-making sessions across Sydney and Melbourne, Australia. Our brand voice is warm, playful, and a little cheeky. We run paid Meta ads 
 + Instagram) to drive bookings and are looking for a long-term editor to scale our ad creative output.



The Role



You'll be editing short-form video ads (mostly 9:16) for our Meta ad campaigns. This is a pure editing role, I handle the strategy, hooks, scripts, and provide all raw footage. You take the brief and execute.



What I provide:

- The hook/script

- Creative direction and reference ads

- Brand guidelines (fonts, colours, vibe)

- Light motion graphics / text animations

- Deliver 2–3 variants per ad concept(different hooks, intros, or CTAs) for A/B testing

Must-haves:



- Proven experience editing short-form content for Meta/TikTok (link your portfolio)

- Deep understanding of scroll-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and ad-style editing (this is NOT vlog editing)

- Fluent written and verbal English

- Use of AI narration tools such as Elleven labs and AI video such as Higgsfield

Available for async communication during AEST business hours (a few hours of overlap is fine)



Nice-to-haves:



- Experience with DTC / experience-based / lifestyle brands

- Basic colour grading

- Motion graphics chops (After Effects)



Hours & Pay:

Starting at ~10–15 hours/week with scope to grow. Hourly rate negotiable based on portfolio and trial output. Long-term role — I'm not looking for one-off freelance.



Trial:

Before any long-term arrangement, I'll pay for a single test ad edit (you keep the pay regardless of outcome). This is how we'll both d
 if it's a fit.



HOW TO APPLY - read carefully:



1. Start your application with the word "TUFTTEA" at the very top. Applications without this will be deleted.

2. Share 2–3 short-form video ads you've personally edited (Meta, TikTok, or Reels). Tell me what your role was on each one.

4. What's your preferred editing software, and roughly how long does it take you to turn around a 20–30 second ad from raw footage?

At Sailor Health, we envision a world where every senior has seamless access to compassionate, effective, and personalized mental health care. Join us on our mission to redefine the golden years, enabling older adults across the nation to live happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.



About the Role

Title: Medical Claims Billing Specialist

Location: Remote – Philippines only

We’re hiring a full-time remote Medical Claims Billing Specialist to support Sailor Health’s growing Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a highly execution-driven role focused on ensuring claims are submitted accurately, worked quickly, and reimbursed efficiently.



You will spend the majority of your day submitting medical claims, following up with insurance payers, resolving denials, correcting claim issues, and ensuring timely payment across Medicare and commercial insurance plans. Your work will directly impact the financial health of the company and help ensure patients can continue accessing care without interruption.



This role sits at the intersection of operations, billing, and payer management. It is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, persistent, and experienced in U.S. healthcare billing workflows.



Experience in all of the following is absolutely mandatory:

-Medical claims billing

-Revenue cycle management (RCM)

-Insurance claims follow-up and denials management

-Prior experience working in U.S. healthcare

-Submit medical claims accurately and efficiently to insurance payers

-Work directly with insurance companies to resolve billing and reimbursement issues

-Identify and resolve claim errors, eligibility issues, authorization gaps, and payer rejections

-Submit corrected claims and manage appeals when necessary

-Maintain accurate documentation and claim status updates across internal systems

-Monitor aging claims and proactively escalate high-risk accounts or payer issues

-Partner closely with intake, credentialing, clinical, and operations teams to resolve claim blockers quickly

-Ensure timely and accurate workflows related to reimbursement and collections

-Continuously improve billing workflows, operational efficiency, and claim turnaround time



Qualifications

-Experience working with Medicare and commercial insurance payers strongly preferred

-Strong understanding of claims submission, denials management, appeals, and payer follow-up workflows

-Extremely detail-oriented and organized

-Strong written and verbal English communication skills

-Comfortable handling high-volume operational work with speed and accuracy

-Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

-Experience using EHRs, billing systems, clearinghouses, or insurance portals preferred



Why Join Sailor Health

-Mission with impact. Help bring life-changing care to a population that’s too often overlooked.

-Remote-first team. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while staying closely connected with a thoughtful, collaborative team rooted in purpose.

-Growth and ownership. Be part of a small, agile team where you’ll take initiative, shape key processes, and grow as we grow.

-Make someone’s day – every day. Your work helps older adults and their families feel seen, supported, and cared for.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Job Summary

This position is for a highly motivated and exceptionally organized Legal Assistant within a fast-paced legal environment. This hybrid role is essential to the success of our practice, providing a full range of support to attorneys in both pre-litigation and litigation phases.



The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong technical skills and a client-focused attitude. You will be responsible for a blend of paralegal and legal assistant duties, managing case files from inception through resolution.



Core Responsibilities

Administrative & Client Support

• Answer and screen incoming phone calls, acting as a professional first point of contact for clients, opposing counsel, and courts.

• Handle, process, and distribute all incoming/outgoing faxes and mail.

• Serve as a key point of contact for clients, providing non-legal status updates and gathering necessary information.

• Perform conflict checks for all potential new matters.

• Open new client matters and maintain physical and electronic files in accordance with firm standards.



Case Management & Development

• Maintain and meticulously update the firm's case management software with deadlines, contact information, case status, and notes.

• Manage and maintain attorney calendars, including scheduling appointments, calls, and critical case deadlines.

• Draft and send letters of representation to clients, opposing counsel, insurance carriers, and healthcare providers.

• Obtain, track, and follow up on all case-related records, including medical bills/reports, employment records, police reports, and insurance information.

• Draft detailed medical summaries and chronologies.

• Acknowledge and track liens from providers, insurers, and government agencies (e.g., Medicare/Medicaid).

• Assist attorneys with the preparation and assembly of settlement demand packages.



Litigation & Discovery

• Assist with drafting initial pleadings, including Summons, Complaints, and Answers.

• Coordinate service of process for summonses, complaints, and subpoenas.

• Draft outgoing discovery, including Form Interrogatories, Special Interrogatories, Requests for Production of Documents, and Requests for Admission.

• Prepare "skeletons" for discovery responses, coordinate the collection of responsive documents and information from the client, and prepare final responses.

• Organize and Bates stamp document productions (both incoming and outgoing).

• Review and analyze discovery responses from other parties, identifying deficiencies and assisting with "meet and confer" correspondence.

• Prepare and issue deposition and records subpoenas.

• Schedule depositions, mediations, and hearings, including coordinating with all parties, court reporters, and videographers.

• Prepare and serve Notices of Deposition (NODs) and other hearing notices.

• Set up and manage remote appearances (e.g., via Zoom or court-specific portals).

Motion, Trial, & Case Resolution

• Assist with drafting notices of motion and declarations; prepare and organize motion exhibits.

• Assist with trial preparation, including the creation of exhibit binders, witness lists, and trial binders.

• Coordinate and communicate with expert witnesses to schedule, obtain reports, and prepare expert designations.

• Prepare, serve, and electronically file various legal documents in state and federal courts (e.g., OneLegal, File&Serve, CM/ECF).

• Negotiate lien reductions with medical providers and insurers.

• Prepare and file CMS-related documents and declarations.

• Draft settlement agreements, releases, and Requests for Dismissal.

• Prepare final distributions/disbursement schedules and corresponding check letters for clients and providers.

• Handle all file-closing procedures, including archiving documents and returning original materials to the client.



Qualifications & Skills

• Experience: 3+ years of experience as a legal assistant or paralegal in a civil litigation environment. Experience in personal injury legal assistant work in California is a plus. 

• Education: Paralegal Certificate or equivalent combination of education and experience is a plus.

Technical Skills:

o High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel).

o Experience with case management software (e.g., PracticePanther, Clio, MyCase, ProLaw, etc.).

o Proficiency with PDF software (e.g., Adobe Acrobat) for Bates stamping, redacting, and exhibits.

o Experience with state and federal e-filing portals is required.

Core Competencies:

o Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

o Strong written and verbal communication skills.

o Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively under pressure.

o Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

o Understands and maintains strict confidentiality.

mbers come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and 
nts of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.

mbers can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named:

San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024 and 2025, and Inc. 5000 for the last 6 years (
)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Receivable Coordinator is responsible for managing the end-to-end receivables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes generating and sending client invoices, monitoring payment status, following up on outstanding balances, and reconciling payments in the accounting system. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to the Finance Operations Manager



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Generate and distribute client invoices for active accounts across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Monitor payment receipt and update the AR ledger in the accounting system

Follow up on outstanding invoices via
 and phone according to collections cadence

Record and apply incoming payments, credits, and adjustments accurately

Flag any disputed invoices or non-payment risks to the Finance team.

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AR snapshot including outstanding balances, collections activity, aged items, and any client billing escalations requiring a decision

Monthly

Prepare and distribute the monthly AR aging report

Conduct a full reconciliation of client payments against invoiced amounts

Escalate unresolved collections issues with clear documentation and recommended next steps

Support month-end close by delivering complete and accurate AR data on schedule

Maintain organized records of all invoices, payment confirmations, and client correspondence

Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AR documentation as requested

Identify patterns in late payments and recommend adjustments to billing or collections processes

Support client account reconciliation requests and statement generation

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Performance Metrics

Invoice accuracy and on-time delivery (target: 100?ch billing cycle)

AR aging performance (target: less than 10% of balances aged beyond 30 days)

Collections follow-through rate and documentation quality

On-time delivery of monthly AR aging report

Completeness and accuracy of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Generate accurate, timely invoices for all active client accounts. Ensure invoices reflect current service packages, pricing, and entity assignment. Send invoices through the appropriate channel and confirm receipt when needed.

Collections and Follow-Up: Execute a consistent collections cadence for outstanding balances. Communicate professionally with clients to resolve payment delays while preserving the client relationship. Escalate persistent non-payment issues with clear documentation and recommended action. Client-facing communication on billing disputes routes through the HR and Finance Specialist or leadership; the AR Coordinator is responsible for flagging, documenting, and preparing context for escalation rather than owning direct client resolution independently.

Client Billing Documentation: Maintain account-level billing notes for clients with complex histories, special billing arrangements, or ongoing disputes. Ensure institutional knowledge is documented so context is accessible during transitions or escalations and does not rely on individual memory.

Payment Reconciliation: Apply all incoming payments accurately to client accounts in the accounting system. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between invoiced amounts and payments received. Ensure credits, adjustments, and write-offs are processed with proper approvals.

AR Reporting: Maintain a current and accurate AR aging report. Deliver monthly reporting to the HR and Finance Specialist and leadership on time. Provide clear visibility into outstanding balances, collections risk, and month-over-month trends.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage receivables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), ensuring accurate entity coding and clear separation of client records.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You verify invoice accuracy before sending, apply payments to the correct accounts, and catch discrepancies before they compound. Precision is non-negotiable in this role.

Professional Communication: You follow up on outstanding invoices with confidence and professionalism. You can hold a firm position on payment timelines without damaging client relationships. Your written communication is clear, polished, and free of ambiguity.

Organization and Prioritization: You manage a high volume of client accounts simultaneously and know how to triage collections activity by urgency and risk. You maintain complete records without being asked.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new platforms quickly. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar tools is required. Familiarity with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus

Integrity and Discretion: You handle sensitive client account information with professionalism and confidentiality. You operate with consistency and honesty in all financial record keeping.



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts receivable, billing, or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for client and internal communication

Experience with collections follow-up and comfortable having direct conversations about payment timelines

High attention to detail and ability to manage a large volume of client accounts accurately

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment application authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort applying payments and initiating adjustments within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Experience in a subscription-based or recurring billing environment

Familiarity with Rippling, Stripe, HubSpot billing, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting operations

description:
Who We Are

TaskOn eCommerce is a Klaviyo Master Platinum Partner and retention marketing agency. We help 7–8 figure DTC brands on Shopify grow revenue through
, SMS, loyalty, and owned-channel strategies — and we also manage Amazon Vendor Central (1P) for select clients. Our clients operate in high-growth verticals: health & wellness, pet supplies, beauty, and sports/outdoor.

The Role

We're hiring a sharp, experienced Cold Caller to be the first voice prospects hear from TaskOn eCommerce.



Your mission is simple but critical: reach the right people, open the right conversations, and book qualified discovery calls with our leadership team. You'll be calling DTC brand founders, eCommerce directors, and Amazon decision-makers — busy, high-level people who don't waste time. Neither do we.



This is a high-activity outbound role. You'll be set up for success with a strong value proposition, clear target client profiles, and call frameworks built collaboratively with you. What we need from you is the drive, the professionalism, and the people skills to make it work.



This role requires working Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours. Applicants who cannot commit to PST hours will not be considered.



What You'll Do

• Make outbound calls daily to DTC brand founders and key decision-makers

• Follow call frameworks while adapting naturally — you're a human, not a robot

• Qualify prospects against criteria set by leadership

• Book discovery calls directly onto the calendar of our President & Founder

• Log all activity, outcomes, and notes accurately in our CRM

• Follow up via phone and
 as needed

• Submit daily or weekly activity summaries to leadership



What We're Looking For

This role is for experienced cold callers only. Please do not apply if you have not worked in outbound calling with proven, measurable results.

• 3+ years of cold calling experience with a documented track record of booking meetings (this is a firm requirement, non-negotiable)

• Fluent English with clear, confident, and professional phone communication

• Proven ability to book qualified meetings with business owners and senior decision-makers

• Comfortable holding your own in conversations with founders and C-level contacts

• Highly organized, self-motivated, and accountable. You don't need to be chased

• Coachable. You work within frameworks while bringing your own energy and instincts

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling setup

• Experience with CRM tools and call tracking is a plus

• Background in eCommerce, Shopify, or digital marketing is a strong plus



Your First 90 Days

We don't drop people into roles and hope for the best. You'll receive clearly defined 30, 60, and 90-day targets when you join. These aren't meant to pressure you — they're your roadmap. The right person will welcome them.



What Success Looks Like

• A consistent, high volume of outbound calls made every day

• Qualified discovery calls booked and showing up on our calendar

• Clean, accurate CRM records — every call logged

• Hitting the targets we set together



Compensation

This role includes a base salary plus a two-tier commission structure:

• Earn commission for each completed discovery call that meets our qualification criteria

• Earn a larger bonus when a prospect converts into a paying client

You're rewarded for both consistent activity and real results.



How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you're the right fit for this role.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. No exceptions.

title: Real Estate Research VA
description:
I’m looking for a full-time VA to help with U.S. real estate research and data work.

This is not a calling role to start.



You do not need to be a real estate expert.



You do need to be careful, responsible, organized, and willing to learn a specific process.



Main tasks



* Research mobile home parks in specific U.S. counties

* Find property owner information

* Use websites like Google, county records, FastPeopleSearch, and other public data sources

* Identify if the owner appears to be an individual, family, small operator, LLC, or larger company

* Add clean notes into Google Sheets

* Follow written and video SOPs

* Flag the strongest opportunities

* Send a clear end-of-shift update each day

I’m looking for someone who takes ownership.



That means:



* You show up when you say you will

* You track your time properly

* You ask questions when something is unclear

* You communicate instead of disappearing

* You care about the quality of your work

* You can follow a process without needing constant reminders

I don’t expect perfection.



I do expect honesty, consistency, and clear communication.

If I have to constantly chase updates, fix basic issues, or create every tiny task for you, the hours will naturally become less.



I pay weekly every Friday through GCash.



I cover sending and receiving fees.

Preferred schedule:



* 4 hours can be during your preferred time

Requirements

*

You must be able to access:

title: Administrator Assistant
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Disaster Solutions Australia is a leading provider of comprehensive disaster management services, specializing in helping businesses and organisations respond to and recover from emergencies.



The Project Administrator & Assistant is responsible for supporting the efficient planning, coordination, support and delivery of projects. This role ensures that projects are executed in accordance with company standards, client expectations, and operational requirements.



Working closely with internal departments, field teams, subcontractors, and clients, the position plays a key role in maintaining accurate documentation, supporting the coordination of resources, and facilitating clear communication throughout all stages of the project life cycle.

This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to perform in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.





Key Responsibilities:

• Create and set up new projects in internal systems accurately and in a timely manner

• Ensure all project details, scopes, client information, and job data are correctly entered

• Maintain and continuously update project files to reflect current status and changes

• Ensure all required documentation is uploaded, stored, and easily accessible

• Assisting the implementation of projects, including client and customer communications, coordination of field staff and trades, and collecting field data from trades and staff.

• Tracking projects to ensure they continually address defined objectives and produce the committed deliverables.

• Compiling results and producing project reports, including outcomes and progress of works and communicating these with the customers and the clients daily.

• Coordination for the delivery of services effectively and efficiently.

• Maintaining communication logs for all project-related correspondence

• Support Estimators/Supervisors with cross-service integration efforts to achieve a seamless client experience.

• Assist in maintaining positive client and customer relations throughout all project phases.

• Assist in the evaluation and solution of potential field problems, escalating them to the Project Coordinator Team Leader if necessary.



• Development of costings associated with new internal projects

• Assist in scope analysis to provide clear, documented, and coordinated interpretations to the field teams

• Conduct quality control activities of field work, your reports, etc and ensure your KPIs are met.

• Ensure all projects are updated and accurately created, produced, and generate documents.

• Coordinate and participate in an ongoing project, research, and analysis on cost in relation to workforce management are being captured effectively

• Assist with field staff requests to resolve field issues.

• Scheduling field staff and trades and tracking all assigned projects to ensure they continually address defined objectives and produce the committed deliverables.
